name: api-tests-restful-booker
description: API tests for Restful Booker — Postman, Newman, GitHub Actions

scripts.test: newman run postman/Restful-Booker.postman_collection.json -e postman/Restful-Booker.postman_environment.json --timeout-request 15000 --reporters cli,json,htmlextra --reporter-json-export reports/newman-report.json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful Booker API tests"
scripts.test:ci: newman run postman/Restful-Booker.postman_collection.json -e postman/Restful-Booker.postman_environment.json --timeout-request 20000 --reporters cli,json,junit,htmlextra --reporter-json-export reports/newman-report.json --reporter-junit-export reports/newman-report.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful Booker API tests" --reporter-cli-no-banner
